title: Does RamosLabs indigo (#4f46e5) meet WCAG contrast requirements?
summary: #4f46e5 on white measures 6.29:1: it meets the WCAG AA contrast minimums for text and UI components, and falls short of the 7:1 AAA level.
short: Yes for AA. `--color-primary` (#4f46e5){ref:ds-tokens} measures 6.29:1 on white{ref:measured}: above the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text{ref:sc143} and the 3:1 minimum for UI components{ref:sc1411}, and below the 7:1 of the Enhanced level{ref:sc146}. White text on `--color-primary-dark` (#4338ca) measures 7.90:1{ref:measured}, which clears 7:1.

sections.heading: A primary button with a visible focus ring
body: `--shadow-focus` is a 2px white gap followed by a ring in #4f46e5{ref:ds-tokens}. Against the white gap and the page the ring measures 6.29:1{ref:measured}, above the 3:1 asked of UI components{ref:sc1411}. The DS rule is to never remove the focus outline without an equivalent replacement{ref:ds-agents}.

sections.heading: Verify a pair with the MCP check_contrast tool
body: The DS MCP server exposes `check_contrast` among seven read-only tools, over Streamable HTTP with no authentication, at `https://design.ramoslabs.com/mcp`{ref:ds-mcp}. Call it with a foreground and a background and read the verdicts it returns.

faq.q: Is #4f46e5 accessible on a white background?
faq.a: For AA, yes: it measures 6.29:1{ref:measured}, above 4.5:1 for text{ref:sc143} and 3:1 for UI components{ref:sc1411}. It is below the 7:1 of AAA for text{ref:sc146}.

faq.q: Can I use indigo 300 for text on white?
faq.a: No. `--color-indigo-300` (#a5b4fc) measures 1.99:1 on white{ref:measured}, below both 4.5:1{ref:sc143} and 3:1{ref:sc1411}.

faq.q: Which indigo should I use when AAA is required?
faq.a: Use `--color-primary-dark` (#4338ca){ref:ds-tokens}: white text on it measures 7.90:1{ref:measured}, which reaches 7:1{ref:sc146}.

faq.q: Can I put white text on the primary button?
faq.a: Yes. White on `--color-primary` measures 6.29:1{ref:measured}, which meets AA for text{ref:sc143}.

faq.q: Does the primary indigo have enough contrast for a focus ring?
faq.a: Yes by the numbers: 6.29:1 against white{ref:measured}, above the 3:1 asked of UI components{ref:sc1411}. The DS focus ring uses it{ref:ds-tokens}.

faq.q: How can I check a color pair programmatically?
faq.a: Use the `check_contrast` tool on the DS MCP server{ref:ds-mcp}, or run the script on this page against the token values{ref:wcag22}.
